entries.title: Genesis 45:1
segments: ¶Then Joseph could not refrain himself before all them that stood by him; and he cried, Cause every man to go out from me. And there stood no man with him, while Joseph made himself known unto his brethren.

words.text: himself before all them that stood

entries.title: Genesis 45:2
segments: And he wept aloud: and the Egyptians and the house of Pharaoh heard. {wept...: Heb. gave forth his voice in weeping}

words.text: . {wept...: Heb. gave forth his voice in weeping}

entries.title: Genesis 45:3
segments: And Joseph said unto his brethren, I [am] Joseph; doth my father yet live? And his brethren could not answer him; for they were troubled at his presence. {troubled: or, terrified}

entries.title: Genesis 45:4
segments: And Joseph said unto his brethren, Come near to me, I pray you. And they came near. And he said, I [am] Joseph your brother, whom ye sold into Egypt.

words.text: to me, I pray you. And they came near

entries.title: Genesis 45:5
segments: Now therefore be not grieved, nor angry with yourselves, that ye sold me hither: for God did send me before you to preserve life. {nor...: Heb. neither let there be anger in your eyes}

words.text: . {nor...: Heb. neither let there be anger in your eyes}

entries.title: Genesis 45:6
segments: For these two years [hath] the famine [been] in the land: and yet [there are] five years, in the which [there shall] neither [be] earing nor harvest.

entries.title: Genesis 45:7
segments: And God sent me before you to preserve you a posterity in the earth, and to save your lives by a great deliverance. {to preserve...: Heb. to put for you a remnant}

words.text: . {to preserve...: Heb. to put for you a remnant}

entries.title: Genesis 45:8
segments: So now [it was] not you [that] sent me hither, but God: and he hath made me a father to Pharaoh, and lord of all his house, and a ruler throughout all the land of Egypt.

words.text: So now [it was] not you [that] sent

entries.title: Genesis 45:9
segments: Haste ye, and go up to my father, and say unto him, Thus saith thy son Joseph, God hath made me lord of all Egypt: come down unto me, tarry not:

entries.title: Genesis 45:10
segments: And thou shalt dwell in the land of Goshen, and thou shalt be near unto me, thou, and thy children, and thy children's children, and thy flocks, and thy herds, and all that thou hast:

words.text: unto me, thou, and thy children

entries.title: Genesis 45:11
segments: And there will I nourish thee; for yet [there are] five years of famine; lest thou, and thy household, and all that thou hast, come to poverty.

words.text: , and all that thou hast, come to poverty

entries.title: Genesis 45:12
segments: And, behold, your eyes see, and the eyes of my brother Benjamin, that [it is] my mouth that speaketh unto you.

entries.title: Genesis 45:13
segments: And ye shall tell my father of all my glory in Egypt, and of all that ye have seen; and ye shall haste and bring down my father hither.

words.text: , and of all that ye have seen

entries.title: Genesis 45:14
segments: And he fell upon his brother Benjamin's neck, and wept; and Benjamin wept upon his neck.

entries.title: Genesis 45:15
segments: Moreover he kissed all his brethren, and wept upon them: and after that his brethren talked with him.

entries.title: Genesis 45:16
segments: ¶And the fame thereof was heard in Pharaoh's house, saying, Joseph's brethren are come: and it pleased Pharaoh well, and his servants. {pleased...: Heb. was good in the eyes of Pharaoh}

words.text: . {pleased...: Heb. was good in the eyes of Pharaoh}

entries.title: Genesis 45:17
segments: And Pharaoh said unto Joseph, Say unto thy brethren, This do ye; lade your beasts, and go, get you unto the land of Canaan;

entries.title: Genesis 45:18
segments: And take your father and your households, and come unto me: and I will give you the good of the land of Egypt, and ye shall eat the fat of the land.

words.text: unto me: and I will give

entries.title: Genesis 45:19
segments: Now thou art commanded, this do ye; take you wagons out of the land of Egypt for your little ones, and for your wives, and bring your father, and come.

entries.title: Genesis 45:20
segments: Also regard not your stuff; for the good of all the land of Egypt [is] yours. {regard...: Heb. let not your eye spare, etc.}

words.text: [is] yours. {regard...: Heb. let not your eye spare, etc.}

entries.title: Genesis 45:21
segments: And the children of Israel did so: and Joseph gave them wagons, according to the commandment of Pharaoh, and gave them provision for the way. {commandment: Heb. mouth}

entries.title: Genesis 45:22
segments: To all of them he gave each man changes of raiment; but to Benjamin he gave three hundred [pieces] of silver, and five changes of raiment.

words.text: To all of them he gave

entries.title: Genesis 45:23
segments: And to his father he sent after this [manner]; ten asses laden with the good things of Egypt, and ten she asses laden with corn and bread and meat for his father by the way. {laden...: Heb. carrying}

entries.title: Genesis 45:24
segments: So he sent his brethren away, and they departed: and he said unto them, See that ye fall not out by the way.

words.text: unto them, See that ye fall not out

entries.title: Genesis 45:25
segments: ¶And they went up out of Egypt, and came into the land of Canaan unto Jacob their father,

entries.title: Genesis 45:26
segments: And told him, saying, Joseph [is] yet alive, and he [is] governor over all the land of Egypt. And Jacob's heart fainted, for he believed them not. {Jacob's: Heb. his}

entries.title: Genesis 45:27
segments: And they told him all the words of Joseph, which he had said unto them: and when he saw the wagons which Joseph had sent to carry him, the spirit of Jacob their father revived:

words.text: unto them: and when he saw

entries.title: Genesis 45:28
segments: And Israel said, [It is] enough; Joseph my son [is] yet alive: I will go and see him before I die.
